LanguageData.HE_Nord_Longhouse.label: longhouse hearth
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Longhouse.description: A long stone-lined fire pit that warms a whole hall and cooks the evening meal.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Planks.label: split planks
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Planks.description: Split logs along the grain into wide planks for floors and benches.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HuntBow.label: hunting bow
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HuntBow.description: A simple elm bow for deer in the pine forests, quick to make and quick to draw.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Fur.label: fur and wool
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Fur.description: Sew heavy fur cloaks and thick woollen tunics for the long winters.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Skyr.label: skyr
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Skyr.description: Curdle skimmed milk into skyr, a thick sour dairy that keeps through the winter.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Runes.label: rune stones
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Runes.description: Carve runes into standing stones to remember the dead and boast of the living.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Blood.label: northern blood
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Blood.description:
Children who bathe in icy rivers grow into adults who do not notice the cold.
Tradition: Colonists are comfortable at temperatures 8°C colder.
Requires 15 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Hunting.label: hunting lore
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Hunting.description:
Read tracks in snow and move downwind: the hunters' lore is passed from parent to child.
Tradition: Colonists gain +10% hunting stealth and +1 shooting accuracy.
Requires 15 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Saga.label: saga telling
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Saga.description:
On winter nights the skalds recite the deeds of the ancestors. Everyone listens, and everyone learns.
Tradition: Colonists learn 5% faster and gain +5% social impact.
Requires 20 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Smithing.label: Nordheim smithing
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Smithing.description:
Pattern-welded swords and the long-hafted Dane axe, forged from bog iron.
Requires 10 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Byrnie.label: byrnie and round shield
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Byrnie.description:
Thousands of riveted rings make a byrnie. With a spangenhelm and a painted round shield, a warrior is ready for the shield wall.
Requires 25 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_MeadHall.label: mead hall
LanguageData.HE_Nord_MeadHall.description:
Long tables, drinking horns and a jarl's seat: the mead hall is where the people of Nordheim feast, boast and make peace.
Requires 15 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Sauna.label: sauna
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Sauna.description:
A small log house with a stone stove. Steam, birch branches and a roll in the snow keep the body strong.
Tradition: Unlocks the sauna. Colonists gain immunity 10% faster.
Requires 20 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Thing.label: the Thing
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Thing.description:
Free people gather to settle disputes by law instead of the axe. Their voices carry far.
Tradition: Colonists gain +8% negotiation ability.
Requires 25 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Longships.label: longship crews
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Longships.description:
Rowing crews learn to travel light and fast, whether over waves or over land.
Tradition: Your caravans travel 12% faster.
Requires 30 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Berserk.label: berserkergang
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Berserk.description:
Some warriors fight in a fury that ignores wounds and caution alike.
Tradition: Colonists deal 10% more melee damage but have -2 melee dodge chance.
Requires 40 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Valhalla.label: road to Valhalla
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Valhalla.description:
Those who have seen the winter rite no longer fear death, only a dull one.
Tradition: Colonists gain +8% pain shock threshold and +1 melee hit chance.
Requires 50 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
Unlocked by finishing the nation's story.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HarpoonGun.label: harpoon gun
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HarpoonGun.description:
A whaler's gun that throws a barbed iron harpoon on a line. It was made for whales; it works on raiders too.
Requires 35 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_FolkSchools.label: folk high schools
LanguageData.HE_Nord_FolkSchools.description:
Schools without exams where farmers, fishers and smiths learn history, song and the law of the Thing together.
Tradition: Colonists learn 8% faster and research 4% faster.
Requires 45 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BowLoft.label: bow loft
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BowLoft.description:
Hunters and shipwrights put their skills together: a bow too big to draw by hand, spanned with a winch.
Requires 40 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_PowderArms.label: Nordic powder arms
LanguageData.HE_Nord_PowderArms.description:
The Nordheim way of making a matchlock or a flintlock: the barrel, the lock, the stock and the drill to use them.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Nordheim has reached the Age of Powder.
Requires 30 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_SteamArmy.label: Nordic steam army
LanguageData.HE_Nord_SteamArmy.description:
Cartridges, rifled barrels and a uniform: the army Nordheim raised when the factories came.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Nordheim has reached the Age of Steam.
Requires 45 Nordheim knowledge unless this is your heritage.
